about_the_game:
Welcome to Apokerlypse, a strategic card roguelike drawing inspiration from classic 'climbing' or 'shedding' card games – the kind where you race to empty your hand by playing ever-stronger poker-style combinations. Master unique hero abilities, acquire and combine powerful chips with reality-altering effects, and construct devastating decks to outplay your opponents and reign supreme as the ultimate cardsharp of the apocalypse!

Set in the world of its predecessor, Apocalypse Party, you'll return to the infamous post-apocalyptic tavern. But this time, your adversaries aren't hordes of demons from hell – they're the cunning strategies and powerful decks built by other players from across the globe!

While the core goal mirrors traditional shedding card games – empty your hand before your opponents by playing superior combinations – playing it straight is rarely the winning move in Apokerlypse.

Why? Because you have access to...

Heroes with Game-Breaking Abilities

The heroes from Apocalypse Party bring their signature powers to the card table!

Summon a dragon to incinerate entire hands, rip open a Hellgate to turn cards into devastating projectiles, use forbidden alchemy to transmute cards into nothingness, and much more!

Turn the Tables with Spell Cards

Visit the shop to acquire incredibly potent Spell Cards that can snatch victory from the jaws of defeat:

  • Obliterate the entire board with a "Black Hole" and seize the initiative to start a fresh round.

  • Facing an opponent about to win? Freeze them solid with a "Blizzard" and shut down their final play! When you're backed into a corner, unleash these mighty spells to turn the tide!

Rule-Bending Demon Chips

Purchase "Demon Chips" in the shop that fundamentally alter the rules and strategies of the game! Imagine making your Straights infinitely long, or transforming your Full Houses into game-ending "Bombs" (high-ranking plays that trump most combinations). As your run progresses, rarer and more powerful chips become available, offering immense build diversity:

  • Over 140 universal chips usable by any hero.

  • Over 20 unique chips exclusive to each hero.

  • More secrets and surprises await your discovery...

7 Special Card Enchantments

Enhance individual cards in your hand with powerful modifications to create your own ultimate trump cards! Examples include:

  • [Gold]: Earn currency whenever the card is played.

  • [Mimic]: Can transform into any card you need.

  • [Shadow]: Start the game with an extra copy of this card.

DBG Mechanics (Card Acquisition & Culling)

Every player has their own independent deck. You can customize your deck in the shop through acquiring/culling cards, ensuring your draws better fit your build.

Challenge Global Player Builds

Every battle pits you against the asynchronous data of decks crafted by real players worldwide. Each opponent features unique chip combinations and deck strategies.

Analyze their weaknesses and devise the perfect counter-play to triumph!

Place Your Bets! Let the Snowball Roll!

Each victory over an opponent earns you corresponding points.

The stronger the opponent, the more rewards you get! Ensure you have enough points to stay in the tournament.

Of course, you can also choose to gamble big by challenging even tougher opponents.

Any points earned beyond the survival threshold will be converted into bonus rewards!

Ranked Ladder

After an entire tournament run, your ladder score will be calculated based on your final position in the "tower climb."

As your ladder score increases, the strength of the opponents you encounter will gradually rise, eventually becoming outrageous...

But fear not! You too will grow stronger! And ultimately become a legendary cardsharp in the tavern!

Let the whole world see your name!
